561-1479-2841-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Maestros Theater.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

When Nearheath Stalker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Nearheath Stalker
When Nearheath Stalker dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nearheath Stalker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Nearheath Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

193-1124-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
193-1124-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an additional activation of planeswalkers' loyalty abilities until end of turn.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking The Chain Veil.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an additional activation of planeswalkers' loyalty abilities until end of turn.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Great Whale and killing Aminatou due to it having zero loyalty, causing it to be returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}.
Cast Aminatou from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B} plus commander tax.
Repeat steps 2 through 7 one additional time.
Activate Aminatou's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to draw a card and then put a card on top of your library.
Repeat step 13 until the number of loyalty counters on Aminatou is equal to the number of activations of Aminatou's abilities you have remaining this turn.
Repeat steps 4 through 6 until Aminatou dies due to it having zero loyalty and is returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 11.
193-1124-2792.notes: The combo is written to assume that Aminatou has a commander tax of 0, and that The Chain Veil has not been activated during the current turn. If either of these is not true, the costs of the combo may change accordingly.
